caption: December, from The Farmer’s Almanack for 1842, calculated for Boston (1841), p. 29: a woodcut of Capricorn, a verse, the day-by-day weather and the Farmer’s Calendar
alt: A worn almanac page headed December hath 31 days, 1842, with a woodcut of a horned goat in an oval frame of leaves, a six-line verse beginning Stern winter reigns o'er all the land, and below it a column of days with holidays and weather notes (Look out for a snow; Clear and quite cold; Snow is near) beside a column of prose headed Farmer's Calendar.
bibliography: The Farmer’s Almanack for the Year of Our Lord 1842. Jenks & Palmer, 1841, p. 29.
